title: Localized model availability heuristics and procurement triggers
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Goal: Produce a repeatable playbook that converts continuous model-supply signals (latency, availability, variant churn) into deterministic procurement triggers and prioritized mitigation actions for PM, Eng, and Sales. Scope: EMEA and APAC pilot first, hosted+Dedicates only. Deliverables: heuristics matrix, synthetic workload heatmap, threshold-based trigger rules, stakeholder runbook, and handoff checklist for Solutions Eng.
acceptance_criteria: Heuristics matrix submitted and reviewed by Eng/RE/Legal
Regional heatmap with p50/p95/p99 and availability computed from synthetic probes and customer telemetry
Procurement trigger rules (severity levels S1,S2,S3) documented and linked to on-call playbooks
Automation checklist for converting trigger to procurement ticket (sales handoff) created
Stakeholder signoff (B2B sales lead + solutions engineer) recorded

2025-01-22 Ravi Patel: Eng feasibility review — synthetic probe harness exists but needs region tagging; estimate 3 days to add region-aware sampling. Added ENG-2219 dependency.

2025-01-28 Elena Wong (Solutions Eng): Customer interview summary attached — enterprise buyers care more about predictable SLOs than raw model family. Need procurement flow for dedicated reservations.

2025-02-02 Sofia Martinez: First draft heuristics pushed to Confluence. Using median of last 12h p95 as baseline; proposing thresholds: p95 > 300ms => S2, availability < 99.7% => S1. Request product review.
2025-02-04 Ravi Patel: Updated probe results for APAC attached. Noting a spike in availability alerts correlated with provider-side upgrades. Recommend adding provider-provenance field to telemetry.
decisions: Use synthesized workload that mimics 8-token chat and 512-token embedding patterns for heatmap sampling
Baseline windows will be 12-hour rolling for p95 and 7-day rolling for availability
Triggers map to procurement actions: S3 => monitoring alert only; S2 => open procurement-ready investigation ticket; S1 => auto-create reserved-capacity procurement draft and notify Sales

PM: Finalize severity->procurement mapping and run tabletop with Sales on 2025-02-12
